content.text:
**答案:2013 年。**

Maharaj Kishan Bhan 在 2013 年获得 Padma Bhushan,类别是 Civil Service。2013 年 1 月公布获奖名单,2013 年 4 月由总统 Pranab Mukherjee 颁奖。

依据:
- https://www.newindianexpress.com/india/2013/Apr/20/president-mukherjee-confers-padma-awards-469846.html(颁奖报道)
- https://www.news18.com/news/india/padma-awards-5-601001.html(名单中列为 Civil Service)
- https://biospectrumasia.com/influencers/26/4585/padma-bhushan-dr-mk-bhan-to-get-genome-valley-excellence-award-today.html
- https://kaushikbharati.org/papers/obituary_mk_bhan.pdf(讣告中写明 Padma Bhushan (2013))
